The BMS collects the values of 40 server room temperature sensors every 1 min."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P4", "text": "After starting, CH-3 takes about 8 min to reach its rated cooling capacity, and during that time the average temperature of server room B keeps rising. When the average temperature exceeds 27 °C, the NOC operator moves the non-critical server load of server room B to another server room."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P6", "text": "Virtual machine migration proceeds 10 servers at a time, and after each migration it is checked whether the service response time is 200 ms or less. If the response time exceeds the threshold, the operator stops the migration, identifies the cause, and then resumes."},

The team shares the symptoms with the manufacturer's remote support center via video call and receives a diagnosis of compressor motor winding damage."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P10", "text": "Since cooling must meanwhile be done with CH-1 and CH-3 only, the operator raises the setpoint temperature of server room B from 22 °C to 23 °C and establishes a contingency plan for the case where one more chiller stops."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P11", "text": "According to the contingency plan, if only one chiller remains, the operator shuts down all non-critical servers in server room B, notifies the customers, and then keeps only the critical servers running. This plan is discarded once the part replacement is complete."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P12", "text": "At 9:00 a.m. the operator sends the customers a report containing the course of the failure and the results of the actions taken, and the facilities team shares the CH-2 replacement schedule with the NOC."},
